title: Motion-diff bbox selection: pick the connected-component that agrees across consecutive diff pairs (frame-N anchored), not the largest
author: jill (operator-directed 2026-09-21, after diagnosing Front Door Outside alert 72c70d5f crop mismatch)
plan_section: V2-066. New structural fix: replace area-based connected-component selection in infra/frame_diff.py:bbox_from_mask with cross-diff bbox intersection. For frame_N's crop, the correct bbox is the component that appears in BOTH diff(N-1,N) and diff(N,N+1) — i.e. the box anchored to frame_N's content. The current largest-component heuristic picks the trail (motion-blur smear extending forward) for entering subjects because the trail spans more pixels than the silhouette.
trigger: Operator 2026-09-21 ~13:00 EDT diagnostic on alert 72c70d5f-3036-4d4b-bd09-a2e66ff24725 (Front Door Outside, 12:21:05 EDT). After computing per-component data for diff(1,2), diff(2,3), diff(3,4), the operator said verbatim: 'now, for frame 2. If we do 1->2, then calculate 2 boxes, and we do 2->3, and calculate 2 boxes, the box that is similar is the correct one for frame 2'. Confirmed by computation: diff(1,2)[CC2137] bbox=(182,705,332x591) and diff(2,3)[CC5216] bbox=(182,708,332x588) IoU=0.995 — same box, subject's position in frame_002. The current largest-component heuristic in diff(2,3) picks CC4905 (area=201329, x=663) — the trail, not the subject. Same IoU test for frame_003: diff(2,3)[CC4905] vs diff(3,4)[CC2680] IoU=0.996 — these happen to be the largest in both diffs so the existing heuristic happens to work for frame_003 but fails for frame_002 (and any entering subject).
background: infra/frame_diff.py:bbox_from_mask selects the connected component with the largest pixel area. For a moving subject this is the wrong component: the motion-blur trail (pixels revealed as the subject moves) covers more area than the silhouette (subject's body at one frame). The trail spans from where the subject WAS to where it IS, so its bbox is wide and tall. The silhouette is dense and smaller. Symptom: alert 72c70d5f crop_a was empty because the bbox was anchored to x=663 (where subject IS in frame_003) but applied to frame_002 where subject is at x=185. Phase 6B.175 (reverted 2026-09-13) had previously tried a similar structural fix using 3 bboxes (one per diff pair) — it was reverted because it broke stationary subjects. V2-066 keeps the 2-bbox crop count (preserves the reverted fix's intent) but picks bboxes by cross-diff intersection rather than by largest area.

operator_guarantees.two_crops_only: Pipeline still emits 2 crops (crop_a = frame_002, crop_b = frame_003). No third crop introduced (per operator scope: 'calculate 2 boxes' for each diff).
operator_guarantees.cross_diff_intersection: bbox_a = the connected component that exists in BOTH diff(1,2) and diff(2,3) at IoU >= 0.50. bbox_b = the connected component that exists in BOTH diff(2,3) and diff(3,4) at IoU >= 0.50.
operator_guarantees.no_fallback: No fallback. If no cross-diff pair meets IoU>=0.50, emit no crop_a/crop_b (null bbox). Alert proceeds with YOLO + vision alone. Operator directive 2026-09-21 verbatim: 'no - no fallbacks!!!!!' Replaces the V2-066-pre 'fallback to largest' guarantee removed at filing time.
operator_guarantees.no_yolo_in_pipeline: Algorithm does not call YOLO. Time order is determined purely by which connected components appear across consecutive diffs.
operator_guarantees.no_color_or_variance_features: Algorithm does not use RGB color, color variance, color distance, or any clothing-color assumption. Pure spatial IoU on connected-component bboxes.
operator_guarantees.env_tunable_iou_threshold: Per AGENTS.md Step 3 all-knobs-env-tunable rule. IoU threshold is an env knob (default 0.50, e.g. FARMSURV_DIFF_IOU_THRESHOLD).
operator_guarantees.no_listener_restart_yet: Code change ships on a branch; listener restart deferred per the standing directive (no restart while in-flight kanban cards exist).

No new env knobs beyond the IoU threshold.

No change to bbox frame assignment (crop_a still uses bbox_a applied to frame_002, crop_b still uses bbox_b applied to frame_003 — those lines are correct in the current pipeline; only the bbox CALCULATION is wrong).

design_principles: Time order is implicit in the diff pair labels. diff(N-1,N) is anchored to frame_N (the silhouette of frame_N appears in it). diff(N,N+1) is anchored to frame_N+1. The component that appears in BOTH is anchored to the boundary, i.e. to the content common to both pairs — frame_N.
IoU is the natural similarity metric for bboxes. No need for distance metrics or feature vectors. Pure geometry.

IoU threshold default 0.50 = 'mostly overlapping'. Loosening to 0.30 catches partial overlaps (e.g. subject moves during the 1-second window); tightening to 0.70 catches near-identical boxes (subject stationary).
No new module boundaries. The new function lives in infra/frame_diff.py next to bbox_from_mask. The pipeline change is 2 lines in infra/gate.py.
Tests use real frame data, not synthetic. The alert 72c70d5f dataset is the canonical regression test.
No fallback logging. No 'fallback fired' warning. On no-match, bbox is None and the crop slot is empty. YOLO + vision still run; only the crop pre-filter is skipped.
Per AGENTS.md operator 2026-09-19 'no fallback paths' rule: when the cross-diff intersection fails, there is no override. The pipeline emits no crop_a/crop_b. Period.

implementation_notes.key_insight: diff(N-1,N) and diff(N,N+1) both contain the silhouette of frame_N — as the trail from frame_N-1→N and as the silhouette of frame_N in N→N+1. Connected components from the two diffs that share the same bbox are the silhouette of frame_N. The component that's only in one diff is the silhouette of the OTHER frame.
implementation_notes.ios_threshold_sensitivity: IoU 0.50 catches most entering subjects. IoU 0.30 catches subjects that move significantly between consecutive frames (e.g. very fast subjects). IoU 0.70 is too strict for moving subjects — will return None too often.
implementation_notes.computational_cost: Three diff_pair_with_bbox calls instead of two. Connected component computation is O(N) in mask pixels (~2.6M px for 2304x1296 frame). Total: ~50ms additional per alert. Acceptable.
implementation_notes.expected_improvement: Front door entering subject alerts: crop_a now contains subject instead of being empty. Vision LLM can match the subject for known-vehicle/animal/person enrollment.
implementation_notes.regression_acknowledged: Stationary subject alerts (currently passing with largest-component heuristic) will now emit no crop_a/crop_b. YOLO + vision still run on full-frame input, so the alert is still emitted. The crop_a/crop_b was a pre-filter for vision LLM; without it, vision LLM gets the full frame. Trade-off: stationary alerts lose the crop pre-filter but gain correct crops for entering subjects.
implementation_notes.no_fallback_rationale: Per AGENTS.md operator 2026-09-19 'no fallback paths' rule, and operator 2026-09-21 'no - no fallbacks!!!!!' directive. Stationary subjects have a different problem (no motion at all → no diff components) and need a different solution; cross-diff intersection is the right tool for moving subjects. Mixing them with a fallback would re-introduce the original bug for one of the two cases.
